narrative.overview: This records the implemented `/` system in `DemoPage.cs`, not a broader component library. System typography, flat mineral surfaces, plum navigation, and monospaced HTTP details give the small sample a structured developer-tool identity.
keyCharacteristics: Plum navigation and greeting field against a pale neutral canvas.
Compact, ruled facts and endpoint rows.
System sans-serif headings with monospace request details.
dos: Do retain system typography and monospace HTTP details.
Do use flat tonal surfaces and thin dividers rather than shadows.
Do preserve wrapping for variable greeting and response content.
donts: Don't replace the approved plum-and-neutral identity with another palette.
Don't introduce decorative charts or telemetry widgets into this small workbench.
